scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @hanja/server && npm run build -w @hanja/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hanja/contracts && npm run build -w @hanja/stroke-engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @hanja/server" "npm run dev -w @hanja/web"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:run && npm run build
